name: wake
note: Plan 12's party-wake scene, re-tuned in plan 14 WP6 so the wake reads: 24 echoes every 50 ms (the trail reaches 1.2 s back), each halving in 0.6 s, the render covering them lightly (occlude 0.3), and the dream buffer at half opacity on the classic conv3_3 swirl. Echo mix, fade, hue and dream mix sit at the bases the party-wake preset's routes push from. Plan 36 T4: these are values only — `dream.on` is the dream node's switch, and a group preset cannot draw or remove a look-back or a dream (the preset's graph does, on GRAPH).
